description: This file defines utility enums and functions for handling execution environment command parsing, especially focusing on unwrapping shell commands and environment variable assignments. It includes mechanisms to identify and process command tokens, unwrapping nested dispatch wrappers, and handling environment-related command modifications.

classes.name: ExecEnvInvocationUnwrapper
classes.description: A static utility class that provides methods to unwrap and analyze command-line invocations, especially involving environment variable manipulation and shell command wrappers.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Returns the lowercase basename of a given path-like token after trimming whitespace and normalizing separators.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Simplifies a command array by unwrapping environment wrappers, returning the core command array.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Unwraps wrappers around a command and provides metadata about the unwrapping process, such as whether modifiers are used.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a token matches the pattern of an environment variable assignment.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Unwraps nested 'env' dispatch wrappers up to a maximum depth to get the actual command.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Unwraps transparent environment invocations, returning the inner command if valid.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Unwraps nested transparent 'env' wrappers for command resolution.
